name: Dessert Chapter
poeticLine: Stories steeped in sugar, spice — and the slow alchemy of love.
description: A collection born from the warmth of Indian kitchens. Each scent is a recipe — slow, intentional, and deeply comforting. Inspired by sweets that carry memory, by rituals that nourish before they delight.

name: The Wild Within
poeticLine: For those who carry entire forests inside them.
description: A collection for the untamed — bold botanicals, raw earth, and the electricity of things that grow without asking permission. These are scents for people who know themselves.

name: Mood Library
tagline: A fragrance for every state of mind.
poeticLine: Light one. Let it find you.
description: Curated moods for every hour — from the electric clarity of morning to the velvet quiet of midnight. Each candle in this collection is a mood made visible.

name: Nature Chapter
poeticLine: Rain on dry earth. Cedar in morning air. Petrichor, slowly.
description: A love letter to the natural world — petrichor, forest floors, sun-warmed leaves, and the quiet dignity of things that grow slowly. Coming soon.
